Both the streaming and hourly batch architectures have passed the functional test suite in dev, so now we need to settle on the architecture and record the operating plan. Per our normal routine, I'd like to hear the final check from application architecture and the final check from compliance before I record the decision. Once both are heard, I'll record the operating plan using all constraints stated in those checks. Who's ready to go first?

I haven't yet updated the architecture document because the replay test was outside the launch checklist, but this is critical information for the architecture decision.
